  • Subsídio a Formação e desenvolvimento profissional .
  • Day Off no aniversario.
  • Entre outros.


Competências da SIG


Estamos procurando por pessoas que estejam buscando alcançar resultados de forma consistente, mesmo sob circunstâncias difíceis. Colaboradores que consigam criar um ambiente em que todos sejam motivados a dar o seu melhor a fim de que a organização alcance seus objetivos. Se você está sempre buscando novas maneiras de crescer e enfrentar desafios, se trabalha no desenvolvimento de pessoas capazes de conquistar suas metas profissionais além das metas da organização, a SIG tem um lugar para você. Para entregar o melhor aos nossos clientes, nossos colegas constroem uma forte relação com eles e trabalham para apresentar as soluções de que eles precisam. Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Você é alguém que aplica conhecimento de negócios e mercado para promover os objetivos da organização? Você é alguém capaz de criar novas e melhores maneiras de a organização ter sucesso? Se a resposta é “sim”, venha e junte-se a nós.


Nosso Compromisso


A SIG é o lugar onde você pode construir algo incrível. Nós oferecemos uma remuneração competitiva e a oportunidade de trabalho remoto em regime parcial. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira;
um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. Você fará parte de uma equipe altamente motivada e dinâmica, e terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, além de capacitação e orientação profissional junto de colegas de equipe experientes. Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio.


Sobre a SIG


A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor. Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange.

title: Estagiário
description:
Sobre a posição

O/A Estagiário/a atuará como apoio à equipe na pesquisa de informações de mercados, negócios e empresas, apoio a análises financeiras e/ou apoio a projetos de consultoria estratégica para clientes. A posição proporciona uma ótima oportunidade de aprendizado rápido sobre os negócios e o funcionamento de empresas, tanto sob a ótica estratégica como a de mercados de capitais, permitindo conhecer tanto características de trabalho de consultoria como de bancos de investimentos, private equity e outros.


Principais responsabilidades :

· Conduzir pesquisas usando bases de dados existentes, ferramentas de busca e IA para elaboração de estudos em apoio à equipe

· Realizar análises de apoio a estudos de mercado, mapeamento setorial, estudos de benchmarks e identificação de oportunidades de negócios

· Acompanhar tendências de mercado, mantendo-se sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes

· Participar de projetos de consultoria

· Apoiar a preparação de relatórios com diagnóstico e recomendações para clientes


Principais requisitos para a posição :

· Graduandos de Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou Contabilidade

· Bom/ótimo desempenho acadêmico, vontade de aprender, intensidade no trabalho e disciplina de execução

· Capacidade de raciocínio analítico

· Habilidade em utilizar ferramentas (LLMs, Microsoft suite, etc.).

· Fluência em inglês


Diferenciais :

· Estágios anteriores em atividades análogas

· Atividades extracurriculares relevantes

· Noções básicas de macroeconomia, finanças, negócios e atualidades.


Outras informações importantes

· Base em São Paulo/SP

· Trabalho presencial no nosso escritório ou em clientes


Sobre a Novara

A Novara Advisory é uma inovadora empresa de consultoria de negócios, fundada em 2023 por Ivan de Souza, sócio sênior com mais de 35 anos de experiência atuando na América Latina, EUA e Ásia e em posições de liderança em algumas das maiores empresas de consultoria do mundo, como Booz Allen, Accenture e PWC Strategy&.

Somos advisors que focam na criação de valor nas empresas, conectando seus líderes de negócios com investidores estratégicos e financeiros para desenvolver oportunidades de crescimento extraordinárias.

title: Comprador Especialista Em Jeans
description:
Requisitos principais:

  • Conhecimento e vivência em negociação;
  • Conhecimento técnico em jeans (lavagens, modelagens, fornecedores);
  • Experiência prévia trabalhando com produto (compras);
  • Boa capacidade de análise de dados (sell-through, giro, cobertura, margem);
  • Disponibilidadepara viagens a fornecedores;
  • Gosto por varejo.


Missão do cargo

Atuar como referência técnica em jeans, liderando compra, negociação, cadastro e relatórios da categoria. Gerenciar fornecedores com visitas e relacionamento de parceria. Validar mix de produtos, metas de giro, margem, vendas e ciclo de vida. Acompanhar tendências de moda, lavagens e modelagens, e analisar mercado/concorrência com base em dados (sell-through, giro, cobertura, margem).


Responsabilidades principais:

Definição de mix com base na pirâmide de preço, negociação com fornecedores, emissão de ordens de compra, acompanhamento de carteira de pedidos, validação de indicadores para ajuste de planejamento e estoque, participação em feiras/showrooms, visitas a lojas e concorrência, e colaboração com Estilo, Planejamento, VM, Marketing e Vendas.


Requisitos Básicos:

  • Formação: Superior completo (Administração, Economia, Moda ou afins)
  • Especialização desejável: Gestão Estratégica de Varejo, Negociação, Compras
  • Experiência: vivência prévia em Produto (compras) e em jeans (desejável)
  • Informática: Office intermediário/avançado (Excel para análise de dados), Power BI, ERP, IA


Treinamentos e conhecimentos

Compra e negociação, gestão de produto, curso de comprador fashion, gestão de estoque/logística, merchandising, gestão de fornecedores, domínio de produtos do varejo de moda, conhecimento técnico em jeans/denim, análise de dados e disponibilidade para viagens.


Competências

Orientação para resultados, foco no cliente, comunicação, trabalho em equipe, criatividade, relacionamento interpessoal, organização e execução, capacidade analítica, conhecimento técnico, negociação, e gosto por varejo e disponibilidade para viagens.

Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash);

Plataforma de educação coorporativa;

🚍 Vale transporte;

️ Wellhub (Gympass).

title: Analista Sênior De Capital Markets (Foco Em Operações Estruturadas)
description:
SOBRE A TMF GROUP

A TMF Group ajuda seus clientes a operar internacionalmente e 'pertencer' a qualquer lugar do mundo. Nosso trabalho inclui apoiar empresas de todos os tamanhos com serviços como RH e Folha de Pagamento, Contabilidade, Secretariado Corporativo, Governança Global e Administração e Serviços Fiduciários para Finanças Estruturadas, Private Equity e Investimentos Imobiliários. Em 2022 a TMF Group adquiriu a Paraty Capital, uma plataforma brasileira de administração de fundos com foco em fundos de Private Equity, infraestrutura e Venture Capital.


SOBRE A POSIÇÃO

Essa posição é ideal para profissionais com experiência em operações estruturadas, dívida corporativa, securitização, financiamentos e mercado de capitais , que buscam atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e multinacional.


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Realizar o cálculo, controle e reconciliação de dívidas financeiras , elaborando relatórios gerenciais e análises para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Atuar na implementação e aprimoramento de sistemas, controles e processos , com foco em monitoramento de obrigações e eficiência operacional;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar cronogramas de pagamentos, amortizações, juros e demais eventos financeiros , em conformidade com os documentos das transações;
  • Monitorar o ciclo operacional das operações estruturadas, assegurando o cumprimento de obrigações financeiras e não financeiras (covenants, reportes e requisitos contratuais) ;
  • Gerenciar documentação societária e contratual;
  • Participar do acompanhamento de operações locais e cross-border.


SOBRE O SEU PERFIL

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou Engenharia;
  • Experiência prévia com operações estruturadas ;
  • Excel avançado ;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Familiaridade com sistema Akrual será um diferencial.



O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Vale Transporte

  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Vale Refeição / Alimentação

  • Licença Paternidade 20 dias



O QUE TEMOS

Impacto Internacional

Nossa presença global em mais de 80 países permite que você influencie a maneira como diversos clientes globais fazem negócios, bem como retribuir as comunidades globais em que operamos.


Seja parte do One TMF

Na TMF Group, nosso pessoal é o que nos torna quem somos. Nossa empresa prospera com o espírito empreendedor de pessoas proativas que combinam entusiasmo com responsabilidade e prestação de contas.


Um mundo de oportunidades

Independentemente de onde você esteja em sua carreira, a TMF Group abre um mundo de oportunidades onde você fará parte de nossa equipe e receberá suporte em sua jornada profissional.


Sendo uma instituição com oportunidades iguais, TMF Group visa diversidade buscando contratar e desenvolver profissionais talentosos, independentemente de sua idade, raça, etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, religião e educação. Acreditamos que as diferentes historias, origens, e experiências multiculturais de nossos colaboradores são um poderoso elemento para a criação de um ambiente inclusivo e diversificado onde todos se sintam à vontade em demonstrar sua personalidade única e autentica no trabalho. Trabalhamos fortemente para conseguir criar um ambiente de trabalho que reflita as comunidades que servimos e perspectivas únicas que nossa diversa equipe traz para a nossa companhia e clientes.


AVISO: "A TMF Group em nenhum momento solicita qualquer tipo de pagamento como parte do nosso processo seletivo, e sempre contatamos nossos candidatos via contas e plataformas corporativas. Se você foi abordado e com solicitação de pagamento, trata-se de uma fraude. Por favor, verifique se a vaga a qual você está interessado, está publicada em nosso site."

title: Vendedor Externo
description:
Vendedor Externo

Atuação:Blumenau SC e Região

Residir preferencialmente em Blumenau ou Itajaí SC


A Hecke Alimentos está em expansão e busca um Vendedor Externo para atuar em Blumenau e Região SC , com a missão de desenvolver mercado, fortalecer relacionamentos e ampliar a presença dos nossos produtos no varejo alimentar, atacado, distribuição e food service.


Aqui, buscamos mais do que alguém para vender. Buscamos um profissional que goste de estar no campo, enxergue oportunidades, construa parcerias sólidas e queira crescer junto com uma empresa que valoriza disciplina, atitude e resultado.

A Hecke Alimentos é uma empresa brasileira, com atuação nacional no segmento de alimentos, especializada na importação e distribuição de produtos para diferentes canais de venda. Atuamos com foco em qualidade, relacionamento comercial e desenvolvimento de mercado, construindo parcerias de longo prazo com clientes em todo o Brasil.


Principais atividades:

  • Atender aos clientes que fazem parte da carteira;
  • Realizar ofertas e vendas do produtos que fazem parte do portifólio;
  • Cumprir roteiros de visitas, pré determinado pela empresa;
  • Fazer pesquisa de preço, quando necessário;
  • Prospectar novos clientes na areas atendidas;


Requisitos.

  • Ensino médio completo ou superior (cursando ou completo);
  • Experiência em vendas externas;
  • Experiência no segmento de alimentos, varejo alimentar, atacado, distribuição, food service ou bens de consumo será considerada um diferencial importante;
  • Conhecimento emtécnicas de vendas, negociação, prospecção e gestão de carteira de clientes;
  • Boa comunicação, organização, iniciativa e foco em resultados;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuação externa e visitas diárias em campo;
  • CNH ativa e veículo próprio.


Diferenciais

  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Gestão Comercial, Marketing, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comsistemas de pedidos, CRM, aplicativos de força de vendas e pacote Office;
  • Perfil analítico para identificar oportunidades e transformar informações do mercado em ações comerciais.


Perfil que buscamos

  • Procuramos alguém que goste de vender, mas que também saiba construir relacionamento;
  • Um profissionalcomunicativo, persistente, resiliente, responsável e com visão de oportunidade. Alguém que tenha disciplina para executar a rotina comercial, mas também inteligência para entender o cliente, o mercado e o potencial de cada negociação;
  • Buscamos uma pessoa com atitude, comprometimento e vontade de crescer junto com a empresa.


Condições de contratação

  • Regime CLT;
  • Horário comercial, de segunda a sexta-feira;
  • Remuneração fixa compatível com o mercado;
  • Variável Compatível com Mercado;
  • Vale-refeição;

  • Mobilidade/reembolso KM rodado conforme política da empresa;

  • Wellhub

title: Payroll Project Lead | FIXED TERM: 12 MONTHS
description:
Kenvue is currently recruiting for a:

Payroll Project Lead | FIXED TERM: 12 MONTHS

What we do

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.

Who We Are

Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated.  We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.

Role reports to:

Payroll GPO Director

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Jose dos Campos

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

This position will support the Payroll GPO Organization within the region in scope.

Resource is responsible to be the trusted advisor to the service delivery organization, understanding their needs, translating them into business cases and overseeing the execution of projects for the existing solution landscape. This role will also manage the stabilization, anchoring and adoption of the new global solution for the deployed countries identifying potential process improvements and

opportunities in the solution and managing the relationship between the GPO Organization, the Payroll service delivery organization, the new Payroll vendor, IT and other stake holders.

This position will:

  • Partner with local country teams as well as the business architecture leads in process improvement and implementation strategies for the payroll teams relating to Salesforce, Workday, ADP, SAPtime, eTime and other strategic tools and Third-Party Vendors (TPV). Takes direction and participates as a part of the payroll global solutions organization.
  • Partner with countries within the region and Global cross functional teams to support project requirements based on these key initiatives and strategies. Interacts as regional responsible person towards the global process on budget requests and project reporting
  • Ensure the successful adoption and stabilization of the new solution by the service delivery organization and IT teams.
  • Create regional roadmaps and offer support to the country payroll teams.
  • Understand the Payroll business process, how the solutions fulfills those requirements and identify any improvement opportunity leveraging on emerging technologies, market experience and intelligent automation.

Other key expectations:

  • Innovation – Maintain a continual focus on opportunities to innovate, independently research new processes leveraging strategic technologies.
  • Project Leadership – Create detailed project plans, understand multiple project methodologies including waterfall and agile, manage project’s tasks and efforts including in all milestones, resources, finances, and status reporting.
  • Contractor Management – Manage allocated contractor resources and confirm communication of tasks and monitor and manage performance. Partner with Third Party Vendors to deliver solutions on budget and on time.
  • Technology Expertise – Not only understand emerging technologies empowering abilities to execute more efficiently, but train and research to demonstrate an expertise in these technologies.
  • Metric Reporting – Research industry best practice KPI’s and benchmarks. Create and present best in class dashboards depicting regional initiatives, strategies, and challenges.
  • Roadmap Strategy – Understand the region’s policies and regulations to manage intake for preparing long and short-term regional initiative roadmaps.
  • Global and Regional Interaction – This position will focus on 100% international interaction for the countries within region and other stakeholders globally.

As a senior-level contributor and subject matter expert, position holder is expected to perform tasks related to project management and oversight as well as providing status and analysis. Contribute to the identification, development, implementation, and communication of optimization of practices, policies, and/or procedures. Required to work independently and may assist in specialized assignments.

Ensure that deliverables meet or exceed individual objectives, adhere to payroll goals and align with service center compliance strategies.
 

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field.
  • Significant experience in Payroll Operations, Payroll Transformation, Payroll Technology, HR Systems, or related functions.
  • Proven experience managing complex regional or global projects, including both Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of payroll processes, controls, compliance requirements, and service delivery models.
  • Hands-on experience working with payroll and HR technology platforms such as Workday, ADP, Salesforce, SAP Time, eTime, or similar solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technology-enabled solutions and process improvements.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with experience collaborating across global, regional, and local organizations.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors, consultants, and external service providers.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret metrics and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage audiences at multiple organizational levels.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Spanish, with experience working in highly international and cross-cultural teams.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

Role reports to:

Lead Financial Analyst

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Jose dos Campos

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

This position will play a critical role in managing Neutrogena’s (NTG) marketing spend forecasting, financial planning, actuals reporting, and business performance analysis. This role partners closely with Marketing, Media, Sales, and Finance leadership to deliver accurate forecasts, provide actionable business insights, identify risks and opportunities, and support strategic decision-making. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen, analytical rigor, and business partnership skills to influence outcomes and drive continuous process improvement within a matrixed environment. This role reports into the Lead Financial Analyst supporting NTG Cleansing/Acne, Hair, and Body Categories.

Responsibilities (including, but not limited to):

Marketing Spend Forecasting & Financial Consolidations

  • Own and maintain the Total Neutrogena BME (Brand Marketing Expense) tracker, ensuring accuracy and completeness across all reporting cycles.
  • Lead monthly forecasting, annual planning, and OneStream submissions for the Neutrogena portfolio.
  • Manage centrally held expenses, including media, allocations, and agency fees, while communicating updates to business partners and finance team.
  • Ensure accurate integration of SAP actuals, forecast updates, account mappings, and structural or methodology changes.
  • Partner monthly with Marketing and Media teams to align on budget estimates and spending expectations.
  • Analyze month-over-month forecast changes and proactively identify risks and opportunities impacting full-year performance.

Actuals Management & Financial Reporting

  • Oversee BME spend actuals reporting and validation processes.
  • Monitor open purchase orders and partner with stakeholders to ensure timely review and spend visibility.
  • Validate accruals through analysis of forecast versus actual activity and investigate potential discrepancies.
  • Ensure spend is accurately recorded within appropriate accounts and profit centers, coordinating reclasses as needed.
  • Partner with Controllership to ensure actuals are complete, accurate, and fully reconciled.
  • Provide clear explanations of spending variances, business drivers, and emerging financial risks and opportunities.

Category Finance & Commercial Partnership

  • Support assigned categories through the end-to-end Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process.
  • Partner with Marketing, Demand, and Customer Strategy teams to develop forecasts and evaluate commercial opportunities and risks.
  • Communicate key business drivers, forecast changes, and financial implications to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Prepare monthly close commentary and performance analysis, translating financial results into actionable insights.
  • Develop a deep understanding of category performance and serve as a trusted business partner beyond financial reporting.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and enhance forecasting and reporting processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making effectiveness.
  • Support ad hoc analyses, strategic projects, and other responsibilities as assigned.

What we are looking for

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Business Administration
  • Solid experience in Finance and/or Accounting role
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills are required. This role is highly stakeholder-facing and involves regular interaction with U.S. business partners, senior leadership, and cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in FP&A, commercial finance, brand finance, or related analytical roles

Nice to Have:

  • Consumer Packaged Goods experience is highly desirable
  • Professional accounting designation (CA, CMA, CGA, CPA) is an asset

Knowledge & Technical Competency Requirements:

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial reporting tools
  • Experience with financial systems such as SAP and OneStream preferred
  • Demonstrated track-record in influencing business partners with fact-based data
  • Demonstrated strong analytical skills and application of technical accounting knowledge, including knowledge of financial statements, margin analysis, cost optimization, etc.
  • Proven ability to work through ambiguity and manage change effectively
  • Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to work effectively as part of a team

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

About the Role

We are looking for a Project Lead, External Manufacturing Procurement to join our Procurement organization and support our External Manufacturing (EM) network.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading and coordinating key projects related to third-party manufacturers that produce finished goods across various product categories. Acting as the central point of coordination, you will partner closely with Procurement teams, Finance, Supply Chain, and business stakeholders to ensure successful project execution, deliver cost optimization initiatives, and support the financial management of the External Manufacturing organization.

This position offers a unique opportunity to combine project management, financial analysis, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement initiatives in a fast-paced global environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and manage projects initiated by the External Manufacturing Procurement organization, ensuring timely execution and delivery of objectives.
  • Drive project governance, organize cross-functional meetings, monitor milestones, and provide regular status updates to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Coordinate cost optimization and value creation initiatives, including supplier-related savings projects and strategic sourcing opportunities.
  • Support the qualification and onboarding of new external manufacturing partners to improve business competitiveness and supply flexibility.
  • Track, validate, and consolidate monthly financial results for the External Manufacturing organization.
  • Analyze key financial metrics, cost trends, inflation impacts, and procurement performance indicators.
  • Support monthly financial closing activities and ensure the accuracy of procurement-related financial reporting.
  • Maintain and manage procurement data, reports, and legacy systems that support day-to-day business operations.
  • Collaborate with global, regional, and local Procurement teams to ensure alignment and execution excellence.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring high-quality data, effective communication, and successful project outcomes.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Supply Chain, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Experience in Project Management, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related business function.
  • Strong financial acumen and ability to analyze business and financial performance indicators.
  • Experience supporting financial closing processes, cost analysis, savings tracking, or budgeting activities.
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong capability to manage data-driven analyses and reporting.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Proactive mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

What you will do

The Commercial Quality Analyst is responsible will partner with Deliver Commercial in Nova Odessa teams to help optimize or support the end-to-end on quality process with a focus on serving Kenvue customers with excellence. Commercial Quality Analyst will perform detailed analysis with other internal quality areas to solve opportunities identified using advanced systems and process excellence tools.

This position will be based out of Nova Odessa, São Paulo in a 100% on site work scheme.

Key Responsibilities

Act as the Quality Representative for Distribution Center (DC) operations in Nova Odessa, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, GDP/GMP standards, internal procedures, and quality systems.

Review and approve quality documentation related to DC operations, ensuring adherence to quality and regulatory standards.
Monitor and assess quality and compliance risks associated with warehousing and distribution activities, implementing appropriate mitigation actions.

Ensure product quality, traceability, and integrity throughout storage and distribution processes, including support for recalls, complaints, and market actions when required.

Required Qualifications

Solid Experience in a Quality role in Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, OTC Drugs, Cosmetic and/or Food with strong technical skills.
Proficient in both written and spoken English.

Spanish is preferred

Strong analytical and technical skills.

title: Head de Operações
description:
Missão

Liderar e desenvolver a operação de cobrança e recuperação de crédito de operações financeiras agrícolas, assegurando excelência na execução, segurança jurídica, escalabilidade, rastreabilidade e geração de resultados.

Será responsável por estruturar uma operação altamente padronizada, auditável e orientada por dados, capaz de conduzir toda a jornada de recuperação de crédito — desde a cobrança preventiva e extrajudicial até a preparação dos casos para judicialização — preservando a exigibilidade dos créditos, a qualidade das evidências e a efetividade das estratégias adotadas.

Atuará como principal elo entre Operações, Jurídico, Produto, Engenharia e áreas de negócio, transformando desafios operacionais em processos, controles, automações e soluções tecnológicas. Buscamos uma liderança com forte capacidade de execução, profundidade técnica, visão sistêmica e habilidade para construir uma operação escalável por meio de dados, tecnologia, inteligência artificial e melhoria contínua.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a operação de cobrança e recuperação de crédito, garantindo produtividade, qualidade, segurança jurídica e cumprimento dos prazos;
  • Definir a estratégia operacional das carteiras, considerando exposição financeira, estágio da inadimplência, perfil do devedor, garantias disponíveis e expectativa de recuperação;
  • Governar toda a jornada de recuperação, incluindo notificações, negociações, promessas de pagamento, acordos, protestos, negativação, baixas, gestão de garantias e preparação para judicialização;
  • Estruturar, documentar e aprimorar políticas, fluxos, procedimentos, critérios de priorização, níveis de alçada e controles internos;
  • Assegurar a rastreabilidade das ações de cobrança e a adequada formalização de contatos, propostas, acordos, pagamentos, garantias e demais evidências;
  • Garantir, em parceria com o Jurídico, que os casos encaminhados à judicialização estejam completos, fundamentados e documentalmente preparados, preservando a exigibilidade do crédito;
  • Liderar, desenvolver e dimensionar a equipe de acordo com o volume, a complexidade e as prioridades das carteiras, atuando também como referência técnica em casos críticos;
  • Definir e acompanhar indicadores de recuperação, produtividade, aging, acordos, promessas de pagamento, SLAs, custos e qualidade operacional;
  • Conduzir comitês de cobrança e elaborar análises executivas sobre resultados, riscos, estratégias adotadas e oportunidades de recuperação;
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação e ganho de escala, traduzindo necessidades operacionais em requisitos para Produto, Engenharia e fornecedores de tecnologia;
  • Aplicar dados e inteligência artificial na segmentação de carteiras, priorização de casos, recomendação de estratégias e controle da qualidade operacional;
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com clientes, fundos, cedentes, escritórios jurídicos e parceiros especializados, assegurando alinhamento sobre estratégias, prazos e resultados.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência consolidada em liderança de operações de cobrança extrajudicial e recuperação de crédito;

title: Arquitetura Azure
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Azure).

Responsabilidades:

  • Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células).
  • Implementar o ZeroLayer Router HTTP (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS).
  • Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider.
  • Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável).
  • Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada.
  • Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio.
  • Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs.

title: Consultor de Investimentos - WS - Parceiros XP
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Certificação CEA, CFP, CFA, C-PRO R, C-PRO I, CPA-20 e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades

title: Member of the Board of Advisors
description:
About the Company


Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.


Company Website:


About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors


Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.


We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.


Key Responsibilities


  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.


Compensation & Benefits


This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.


Why Join Us


Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham, our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.


Equal Opportunity Statement


Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

title: Member of the Board of Advisors
description:
About the Company


Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.


Company Website:


About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors


Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.


We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.


Key Responsibilities


  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.


Compensation & Benefits


This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.

Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. title: Recruiter
description:
Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


(POSITION TO AT LEAST 2 YEAR EXPERIENCED RECRUITER)


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for an experienced and strategic Executive Recruiter to lead end-to-end hiring processes and support corporate talent acquisition for international clients.

This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR leadership.


What We Offer


  • Compensation of R$5,000 + bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote, working directly with U.S. teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Senior Recruiter, Lead, Manager)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities


  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for corporate and strategic roles
  • Partner with stakeholders to align candidate profiles and hiring needs
  • Source, screen, and interview candidates for the U.S. market
  • Utilize tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms
  • Manage and maintain healthy candidate pipelines
  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience end-to-end
  • Maintain consistent communication with hiring managers and candidates
  • Support strategic hiring initiatives for clients and internal teams


What We’re Looking For


  • 2+ year of experience with Recruitment/Hunting in the American market
  • Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment
  • Strong English communication skills (professional level)
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple requisitions
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have


  • Background in corporate or executive recruitment
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-paced hiring environments
  • Experience working with global stakeholders
  • Experience recruiting for international or U.S. clients is a strong plus



Technical Requirements


  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Regional Business Leader ( US & Canada)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a highly execution- Regional Business Leader to lead E-MAGE ’s market entry and project delivery in the United States/ Canada.

This role is best suited for a Program Director / Senior Project Director from an EPC background, who can manage multiple projects, build teams .


Key Responsibilities

1. Program & Project Delivery (Core)

  • Lead multiple transmission line projects (EPC or EPC-like) across the US
  • Take full responsibility for schedule, cost, quality, and HSE performance
  • Build and implement a program-level project management system

2. Client & Market Engagement

  • Support key client relationships (TSOs, IOUs, large energy users)
  • Contribute to project acquisition through technical and delivery credibility
  • Translate client needs into actionable project execution plans

3. Team Building & Leadership

  • Build and lead the US project delivery and engineering team
  • Drive collaboration between local teams and global HQ (design & technology)
  • Develop a high-performance, execution-focused culture

4. Execution & Delivery Excellence

  • Ensure successful delivery of lighthouse projects in the US market
  • Drive continuous improvement in project execution processes
  • Deliver projects on time, within budget, and to high quality standards


Qualifications

  • Proven experience in EPC companies (power transmission preferred)
  • Background as Program Director / Project Director / Senior PM managing multiple projects
  • Strong track record of end-to-end project delivery
  • Experience working with US utilities (TSO / IOU) is highly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to build teams and drive execution
  • Strong communication skills with client-facing capability

title: Gerente geral - Presencial - Banco de Talentos
description:
Responsável pelo planejamento, organização, gerenciamento e controle de um Centro de Distribuição, envolvendo as áreas Comercial, Logística, Operações e Administrativa, atuando na orientação e acompanhamento de suas atividades e desempenho, garantindo o atingimento das metas estabelecidas, bem como contribuir para o aumento da participação da empresa no mercado, dentro dos prazos, legislação vigente, padrões de, através de adequada alocação de seus recursos humanos, técnicos e materiais.


Vaga de banco de currículos!


Principais Desafios


  • Assegurar a execução da estratégia comercial definida, garantindo a rentabilidade das operações comerciais, o desenvolvimento da área comercial e a ampliação do volume de negócios
  • Garantir em conjunto com a liderança logística e de transporte da unidade, as operações de Distribuição, mantendo o padrão de qualidade de armazenagem e de movimentação dos produtos, bem como a qualidade da entrega dos mesmos em todos os pontos de vendas
  • Garantir a exatidão dos estoques, produto acabado e ativo de giro sob sua responsabilidade, mediante execução das rotinas e monitoramento periódico dos inventários
  • Elaborar o orçamento anual das despesas do Centro de Distribuição, através de análise de históricos e previsões de crescimento, buscando atingir as metas traçadas para atingimento do lucro líquido e o aumento do market share, visando seu cumprimento em conformidade com as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa
  • Garantir a conferência dos caixas do CD bem como conferir o montante de valores enviados para área de controle assegurando a acuracidade financeira
  • Conduzir a gestão de pessoas mantendo a equipe capacitada, habilitada e motivada para realização dos trabalhos


Requisitos para o cargo:


  • Forte experiência em Gestão de Equipes de Vendas, Gestão Orçamentária, Administrativa e conhecimentos de rotinas Operações;
  • Para essa vaga é indispensável habilidade com negociações comerciais;
  • Ensino Superior Completo (desejável pós-graduação)

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Bilingual English Teacher - Remote Role [T]
description:
Role Overview

We are currently inviting qualified ESL teachers to apply for a remote instructional role supporting international learners through our structured online teaching platform.


This is a contract-based teaching position offering self-managed scheduling within a professional global education environment.


Why Join Us

  • Remote teaching structure
  • Self-managed scheduling
  • Access to professional development opportunities
  • Supportive global educator network
  • Dedicated online teaching portal


Core Requirements

·      Bachelor’s Degree or higher

·      Recognized English teaching certification (TESOL / TEFL / TESL – CELTA or equivalent preferred)

·      Minimum of 2 years ESL teaching experience

·      Demonstrated commitment to professional growth and teaching excellence


Professional Qualifications (Preferred)

·      Advanced ESL qualifications (Level 5 equivalent or higher such as CELTA, TKT, DipTESOL, PGCE, MEd, PhDEd)

·      Continuous professional development (CPD) participation

·      Experience with international learners


Language Capability Requirements

·      English proficiency at CEFR C2 (or equivalent) is required

·      Proficiency in at least one additional language at CEFR B1+ or higher is strongly preferred


﻿Teaching Scope

You may support either young learners or adult learners depending on teaching allocation.


Students may include:

  • School-aged learners
  • University students
  • Working professionals
  • Adult learners seeking conversational fluency


All curriculum materials are provided and accessible in advance of teaching sessions.


Next Step

  • Qualified candidates are invited to submit their resume for review.

title: Declaration Drafter (Portuguese/English) - Humanitarian Immigration
description:
Who Are We?


Bueno Law is a trailblazing immigration law firm focused on empowering the Latin American LGBTQ+ community, survivors of domestic violence, victims of human trafficking, and other vulnerable individuals. We provide life-changing legal services to immigrants in the United States, and we’re looking for passionate, people-first individuals to join our remote team.


We specialize in:


  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration.


Your Role as a Declaration Drafter


We are looking for an immigration declaration drafter to join our team of Warriors. We do not require experience; we offer a full training program. The ideal candidate is 100% fluent in English and Portuguese, has excellent writing and communication skills, is detail-oriented and a self-starter. Experience in the Psychological or Social Services field. Must be able to work well with different cultures and languages. We require a positive attitude and someone who strives for finding solutions instead of obstacles.


We would like the new Warrior to be able to commit full-time to this position (9am-6pm PST).


Who we are looking for:


  • Experience in providing psychological or social services
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Portuguese
  • Ability to Multi-Task
  • Strong Analytical Skills
  • Decision-Making ability
  • Strong Research Skills
  • Team Player
  • Excellent Customer Service Skills
  • Highly organized individual
  • Fast learner
  • Honest
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Must match our growth and improvement mindset and help implement efficiency techniques
  • Reliable and dependable
  • Hardworking


Essential Duties And Responsibilities:


  • Drafting client declarations.
  • Schedule appointments and maintain calendars.
  • Write and edit documents from letters to reports and instructional documents.
  • Create and maintain filing systems, both electronic and physical.
  • Handle daily client communications.
  • Maintains filing systems as assigned.
  • Retrieves information as requested from records, email, minutes, and other related documents; prepares written summaries of data when needed.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.


What We Offer:


  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

title: Senior Product Designer — Payments & Billing
description:
This role is open to candidates based in Brazil only.


About SigmaMD


SigmaMD is changing the way people manage their health. We build the platform where modern clinics run their entire business on — clinician apps, patient apps, and the admin tooling behind them — covering charting, a number of embedded AI tools, e-prescribing, labs, scheduling, patient messaging, and the money.


About this role


We're looking for a senior product designer who wants more than screens. You'll own the design of our most demanding domain end to end — the research, the flows, the interface, and a real share of the product thinking behind it.


Your primary surface is Payments & Billing. Today our practices bill patients and employers directly: memberships and plan cycles, employer contracts with coverage rules, eligibility roster feeds, proration, invoices and charge items, refunds and reissues, superbills, and card/ACH processing through our merchant partner.


This is not a domain you can design from a wireframe kit. When a patient joins on the 14th, when an employer covers 60% up to a cap, when a membership pauses mid-cycle and is reinstated — someone has to understand exactly what the numbers do, then design an interface that makes it obvious to a physician who is not an accountant. That person is you.


And the next chapter is big. We're expanding into full insurance billing — claims submission, eligibility verification, remittance posting, denials workflow, and prior authorization via a clearinghouse partnership — so hybrid practices can run membership revenue and insurance revenue side by side. Designing it is the most interesting problem we can offer.


You won't only touch billing. Money and care delivery are inseparable here: a charge item comes from an order, a superbill comes out of a signed note, eligibility gets checked at booking. Expect to design across the EHR itself wherever it meets the money. Fellow product designers, engineers, QA, and our customer success team are all people you'll collaborate with daily. Nobody reports to you, but we expect seniority to show up as more than shipping: reviewing work, sharing the reasoning behind your decisions, and helping the designers around you grow is part of how this role operates day to day. You get real ownership of your surfaces, and a company small enough that you can take any question straight to the person who can answer it.


What you'll do


Design it.

  • Own the full design arc for Payments & Billing: research, information architecture, flows, prototypes, and production-ready screens in Figma.
  • Make dense, numbers-heavy interfaces feel calm and obvious. A physician should never have to think about how billing works.
  • Extend our design system where the domain demands patterns we don't have yet.


Own the product thinking.

  • Shape the roadmap for your area alongside our team and customers.
  • Write the stories engineering builds from — which field, which state transition, what happens at the boundary, what the money does. Our specs are precise, and designers write them here.
  • Help define our move into insurance billing.


Talk to customers — and onboard them yourself.

  • Be on calls and in writing with US physicians and practice administrators, and personally onboard new practices. Sitting with a physician while they configure their billing is the best research you'll ever run.
  • Turn messy operational complaints into design decisions. Most of our best work starts as a frustrated support thread.


Do the math.

  • Model pricing and fee scenarios, reason about proration and cycle boundaries, and stress-test flows against edge cases before they reach a spec. Ambiguity in a billing interface becomes a real charge on someone's bank account.


Make the design team better.

  • Review other designers' work, explain the why behind your decisions, and share what you know. Some of that is people, and some of it is what the team builds on: the design system, the patterns, the way decisions get documented.


What we're looking for


1. Exceptional written and spoken English — our single most important requirement. You'll be on live calls with US clinicians, writing specs engineers build from, and writing directly to customers. We assess this seriously and early.


2. Startup experience in a design or product role. You've worked somewhere small enough that you owned outcomes, not tickets — where the answer to \"who decides this?\" was you. Senior Product Designer, Product Manager, Product Owner, or founder all count.


3. A technical background. You don't need to ship production code, but you should read an API contract comfortably, reason about a data model, and hold your own in a technical discussion without deferring. Front-end experience or a CS/Engineering background is a strong plus.


4. Genuinely comfortable with numbers. You'll design around money. You should enjoy — not tolerate — building the spreadsheet, deriving the proration formula, and stress-testing a pricing model against edge cases.


Plus: 5+ years in product design with real ownership of a domain; a portfolio of complex, information-dense product work (not marketing pages); expert Figma; and writing precise enough that a developer never has to guess.


Who you might be


You're a designer who got restless about why you were designing it, and started owning the product decision itself. Maybe you effectively ran the roadmap for your area at a SaaS company. Maybe you co-founded something small and had to be the designer, the front-end developer, and the person who understood the unit economics all at once. What matters is that you've held both halves at once, been close enough to the code to be dangerous, and had to defend a number to someone who cared about it.


Nice to have


  • Revenue cycle management or insurance billing — claims, eligibility, remittance, denials, prior authorization, clearinghouse integrations. This is where we're heading, and the hardest thing on this list to teach.
  • Payments, billing, subscriptions, or fintech (merchant processing, ACH, PCI, benefits eligibility feeds).
  • Healthcare, digital health, or EHR experience
  • Front-end literacy (HTML/CSS, design tokens) and design-system authorship.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted workflows for research, spec writing, and analysis.


Our values


Teamwork, empathy, and innovation — and caring that on the other end of every decision is a physician trying to run an independent practice and their patients.

title: Video Creator
description:
Job Title: Video Creator / Creative Editor

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Compensation: Retainer that reflects experience, seniority and skill level, + bonuses.

Required Assessment:

Submission Form:

───────────────────────────────

916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies. Our clients range from fast-scaling consumer brands to publicly listed companies, with projects including work for Google, Oracle and TikTok.

───────────────────────────────

THE ROLE:

We're looking for a multi-disciplinary Video Creator / Creative Editor who doesn’t wait to be told that something ‘could be better’. Video Creators produce high-performance content for social media, website and beyond, blending strategy, editing, motion, sound, and narrative into media that drives results, (not just views).

───────────────────────────────

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Edit premium short & long-form content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X
  • Own projects end-to-end, from brief to final delivery
  • Act as your own creative director, i.e. source, create, or generate every asset if needed, including: graphics, motion, sound, etc, to cohesively serve the story
  • Build engaging hooks, retention and pacing
  • Adapt creative styles intelligently to different brands and audiences
  • Deliver strong first drafts

───────────────────────────────

COMPLETE THE ASSESSMENT AND APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

  • 5+ years of professional editing experience
  • A portfolio of social-first content that proves viewer-retention with links to work currently live on social media
  • Advanced Premiere Pro + working After Effects so that you can build from scratch, (not reliant on templates)
  • A strong sense of storytelling, with the ability to independently select and organise footage into a coherent, engaging narrative even without a provided script
  • The ability to work efficiently under pressure and at speed without compromising quality
  • Strong sense for design, photo editing, and branding
  • A strong sound design, colour grading, and audio mixing ability
  • A deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and platform-native editing
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication.

───────────────────────────────

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • You consistently deliver high-quality edits with meticulous attention to detail
  • Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!)
  • You actively look for ways to improve content without being asked
  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project

───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  • 100% remote, flexible working
  • Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  • International brands and creator campaigns
  • Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  • Up-skilling with AI workflows and content systems

───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  • Complete the required creative assessment first:
  • Submit your assessment via this form:
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.

description:
Job Title: Video Creator / Creative Editor

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Compensation: Retainer that reflects experience, seniority and skill level, + bonuses.

Required Assessment:

Submission Form:

───────────────────────────────

916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies. Our clients range from fast-scaling consumer brands to publicly listed companies, with projects including work for Google, Oracle and TikTok.

───────────────────────────────

THE ROLE:

We're looking for a multi-disciplinary Video Creator / Creative Editor who doesn’t wait to be told that something ‘could be better’. Video Creators produce high-performance content for social media, website and beyond, blending strategy, editing, motion, sound, and narrative into media that drives results, (not just views).

───────────────────────────────

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Edit premium short & long-form content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X
  • Own projects end-to-end, from brief to final delivery
  • Act as your own creative director, i.e. source, create, or generate every asset if needed, including: graphics, motion, sound, etc, to cohesively serve the story
  • Build engaging hooks, retention and pacing
  • Adapt creative styles intelligently to different brands and audiences
  • Deliver strong first drafts

───────────────────────────────

COMPLETE THE ASSESSMENT AND APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

  • 5+ years of professional editing experience
  • A portfolio of social-first content that proves viewer-retention with links to work currently live on social media
  • Advanced Premiere Pro + working After Effects so that you can build from scratch, (not reliant on templates)
  • A strong sense of storytelling, with the ability to independently select and organise footage into a coherent, engaging narrative even without a provided script
  • The ability to work efficiently under pressure and at speed without compromising quality
  • Strong sense for design, photo editing, and branding
  • A strong sound design, colour grading, and audio mixing ability
  • A deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and platform-native editing
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication.

───────────────────────────────

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • You consistently deliver high-quality edits with meticulous attention to detail
  • Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!)
  • You actively look for ways to improve content without being asked
  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project

───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  • 100% remote, flexible working
  • Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  • International brands and creator campaigns
  • Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  • Up-skilling with AI workflows and content systems

───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  • Complete the required creative assessment first:
  • Submit your assessment via this form:
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.
