title: Senior Analyst
description:
About Us:


At InTune Analytics our passion is to, “build cool shit with people we enjoy building it with.”

A simple, yet powerful creed that we all try to live by on a daily basis. We’ve spent the past 10+ years building technology in the live entertainment industry. Partnering with some of the industry’s biggest names, we’ve established ourselves as one of the largest, and most sophisticated market makers in the industry.


In each of the past three years we’ve experienced more than 2x growth. We are looking for a senior analyst to join our fast-growing team. The ideal candidate works well under pressure and can lead a team in a time sensitive environment. Driving strategic decisions and actively managing our investment portfolio. They should be very detail oriented, and be comfortable using data to drive insights and action. Additionally, this position will require the ability to communicate with a diverse team and ask strong questions.


Culturally, you're:

  • Highly motivated and thrive in a collaborative team environment
  • Eager to learn the “why” behind our processes
  • A strong communicator who works well with stakeholders
  • Results-oriented and take pride in delivering high-quality work
  • Are comfortable juggling multiple responsibilities at once, and are dynamic under high-pressure and fast-paced environments
  • Entrepreneurial and dynamic
  • Possess a sense of humor and a willingness to grow in a friendly atmosphere
  • Ability to see the bigger picture and make strategic decisions

Technically, you:

  • Detail oriented and hate making small mistakes
  • Connect the dots others miss and translate them into strategic action
  • Have extensive experience building actionable insights from data
  • Are comfortable working with AI to improve your efficiency and effectiveness
  • Are able to learn new processes quickly
  • Strong communication skills in English

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS Pleno/Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


  • Projetar, implementar e manter arquiteturas em nuvem AWS escaláveis, seguras e de alta performance
  • Automatizar provisionamento e gestão de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e/ou CloudFormation (IaC)
  • Monitorar, otimizar desempenho, custos e segurança dos ambientes cloud
  • Definir e implementar boas práticas de autenticação, autorização, criptografia e governança
  • Apoiar squads de desenvolvimento e operações na implementação e evolução de pipelines CI/CD
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade , resiliência, disaster recovery e observabilidade dos sistemas
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada das arquiteturas e soluções implementadas
  • Atuar na resolução de incidentes críticos e na melhoria contínua dos ambientes em nuvem


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em AWS abrangendo serviços de compute (EC2, Lambda), storage (S3, EBS, EFS), networking (VPC, Route 53, Direct Connect), segurança, bancos de dados (RDS, DynamoDB, Aurora), análise e monitoramento
  • Domínio sólido em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) – preferencialmente Terraform e/ou AWS CloudFormation
  • Experiência prática com pipelines CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline/CodeBuild/CodeDeploy)
  • Conhecimento avançado em automação e scripting (Python, Bash/Shell, PowerShell)
  • Forte vivência em segurança na nuvem (IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, VPC peering/endpoints, Security Groups, AWS Organizations, encryption at rest/transit)
  • Familiaridade com containerização e orquestração (Docker, Amazon ECS, EKS ou Kubernetes nativo)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Amazon CloudWatch, X-Ray, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog ou similares)
  • Boa comunicação técnica e habilidade para colaborar com equipes de dev, ops, segurança e negócio



Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Visual Designer
description:
Design Humans is looking for a Mid-Level Contract UI / Visual Designer for our client in the digital and physical design space to help extend and evolve digital product experiences across client work. This role is ideal for a designer with strong visual craft who can take an emerging design direction and turn it into polished, scalable interface systems.


You’ll be joining a small, multidisciplinary team that works across digital and physical design. For this role, we’re specifically looking for someone who is excited by the challenge of making complex products feel clear, thoughtful, and beautifully resolved.


This position is slated for 3 months, fully remote, and open to candidates based in Latin America.


What you’ll do

  • Extend visual systems across product experiences in Figma
  • Turn early design directions into polished UI patterns, screens, and components
  • Help evolve design system thinking across a complex SaaS product
  • Contribute to interface work across additional app and web projects as needed
  • Collaborate closely with design leadership to build on core ideas and push them forward with craft and care


What we’re looking for

  • Strong English fluency
  • Strong visual design skills and high attention to detail
  • Ability to translate an initial concept into a cohesive, scalable product UI
  • Comfort working within evolving systems, not just fully defined ones
  • Experience designing for SaaS, dashboards, or other complex digital products
  • Ability to work across desktop and mobile


You may be a great fit if

  • You have a strong visual point of view
  • You enjoy making complex tools feel elegant and intuitive
  • You can build from a seed of an idea, not just apply patterns mechanically
  • Your portfolio clearly shows what you contributed and how you think through visual decisions


Please note: applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Email Designer at Lilo Social, you will be the creative force behind high-converting email experiences for our portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will transform strategic concepts into beautiful, mobile-optimized email designs that drive engagement, revenue, and long-term customer loyalty. Working closely with retention strategists and copywriters, you will craft email templates that balance brand aesthetics with performance-driven design principles.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently high email engagement rates (open rates, click rates) across your client portfolio through strong visual design
  • Efficient production workflows that allow rapid iteration and testing of design variations
  • Email designs that maintain brand consistency while optimizing for conversion and user experience
  • Positive client feedback on design quality and strong collaboration with cross-functional team members


Responsibilities

  • Create campaign emails, automated flow templates, and promotional designs aligned with client brand guidelines
  • Develop mobile-first email designs that render flawlessly across email clients and devices
  • Collaborate with retention strategists and copywriters to bring campaign concepts to life
  • Iterate quickly on email designs based on performance data and A/B test results
  • Maintain organized design systems and asset libraries for each client account
  • Build reusable email modules and components that streamline production
  • Ensure all emails meet accessibility standards and deliverability best practices
  • Stay current on email design trends, platform updates, and industry innovations
  • Execute QA testing across multiple email clients before campaign launches
  • Support the team with design feedback and contribute to internal design standards
  • Manage multiple client accounts with varying design needs and brand aesthetics


Requirements

  • 2-4 years of experience in email design, digital design, or related field with a strong portfolio demonstrating email work
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for designing email layouts and creating design systems
  • Strong grasp of email marketing best practices including mobile optimization, CTA placement, and visual hierarchy
  • Demonstrated ability to design for conversion while maintaining brand integrity and aesthetic quality
  • Fast iteration speed with ability to produce high-quality work under tight timelines
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across devices
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with strategists, copywriters, and account teams
  • Familiarity with direct-to-consumer brands and ecommerce customer lifecycle marketing


Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or other email service platforms (Mailchimp, Iterable, Braze)
  • Motion graphics or animation capabilities to enhance email interactivity and engagement
  • Experience designing for SMS, push notifications, or other retention marketing channels
  • Understanding of email deliverability factors and how design choices impact inbox placement


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Arquitetura de Soluções Azure - 134713
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com Cloud Azure) para atuação remota e contratação CLT.

Responsabilidades:

  • Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células).
  • Implementar o ZeroLayer Router HTTP (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS).
  • Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider.
  • Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável).
  • Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada.
  • Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio.
  • Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs.
  • Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Larga experiência em Arquitetura de Soluções, Arquitetura de Software ou Cloud Architecture.
  • Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud.
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map.
  • Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção.
  • APIs REST, gRPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos.
  • Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes.
  • Bancos relacionais, NoSQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding.
  • OAuth2, OpenID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade.
  • Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs).
  • Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs.
  • Experiência no setor Financeiro


Desejável:


  • Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture.
  • CQRS.
  • Event Sourcing.
  • Saga Pattern.
  • Outbox Pattern.
  • Consumer Driven Contracts.
  • GraphQL.
  • Apache Pulsar, RabbitMQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria.
  • Java, Go ou .NET.
  • Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS).
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
  • Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102).
  • TOGAF.
  • Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas.
  • Conhecimento de Terraform


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback


Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).


🛠️ Professional Setup Access to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency.


Fully Remote + Flexible Work from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration.


🚀 High-Volume Learning Produce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially.


Application Process:


Step 1: Submit Application

  • Current CV/resume
  • Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted)
  • Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked


Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours.


Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand.


Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns.


Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered.


Good luck! We are excited to meet you!

title: Country Manager
description:
Position Description

1.Market Growth & Business Ownership

  • Own business growth and key market performance for the region, with clear accountability for business outcomes and growth metrics.
  • Analyze market performance, user behavior, and competitive landscape to identify growth opportunities and provide strategic insights to global teams.

2.User Growth & Market Development

  • Build the local market from 0 to 1 by developing scalable user acquisition and growth programs.
  • Drive organic user acquisition through localized social media, KOLs, creator programs, online communities, partnerships, and other community-led initiatives.
  • Increase Tripo's local presence, ecosystem penetration, and user touchpoints across both online and offline channels.

3.Creator Ecosystem & Community

  • Recruit, engage, and retain creators, studios, agencies, and other ecosystem partners.
  • Design creator programs, incentive systems, and community initiatives that strengthen long-term engagement and ecosystem growth.
  • Develop a deep understanding of creator workflows and translate creator feedback into product improvements and business opportunities.

4.Partnerships & Ecosystem Development

  • Build strategic relationships with KOLs, creator communities, educational institutions, media, industry organizations, and ecosystem partners.
  • Expand Tripo's presence within the local creative, AI, and 3D ecosystem through long-term partnerships.
  • Identify partnership opportunities that accelerate user growth and long-term ecosystem development.

5.Localization & Brand Presence

  • Localize messaging, campaigns, and content to better resonate with local creators and users.
  • Manage regional social channels and collaborate with the global marketing team on localized campaigns and paid creative assets.
  • Represent Tripo at conferences, workshops, meetups, creator events, and other industry activities

6.Cross-functional Leadership

  • Serve as the bridge between local users and global Product, Marketing, Growth, and Operations teams.
  • Deliver structured market reporting and recommendations to help shape product roadmap and go-to-market strategy.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in market operations, growth, business development, community, or ecosystem development, preferably in AI, SaaS, gaming, 3D, developer tools, or the creator economy.
  • Strong ownership mindset with accountability for business performance and measurable market growth.
  • Proven experience building markets from 0 to 1 and driving user growth through social media, KOLs, creator communities, partnerships, and other organic growth channels.
  • Deep understanding of local markets, creator ecosystems, and community operations.
  • Good understanding of both consumer (B2C) growth and small business (SMB) customer acquisition and engagement.
  • Data-driven, strategic, and capable of turning insights into actionable business initiatives.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills; bilingual or multilingual candidates are preferred.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and comfortable operating in ambiguity—from strategy to execution, from growth initiatives to event logistics.

description:
Position Details

Job Title: Antenna Sales Manager

Department: Sales — Latin America

Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM

Location: Brazil or Mexico — supporting the LATAM region

Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote (home-office based, customer-facing)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory


Role Objective

Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for antenna products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating antenna design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand antenna penetration within the existing customer base.


Primary Responsibilities

Market Growth & New Business

  • Own LATAM growth for Quectel antenna products and solutions, with a strong focus on new customer acquisition, new verticals, and share expansion.
  • Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value, and design-win potential.
  • Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to position antennas alongside modules and connectivity solutions.
  • Develop account strategies for OEMs, ODMs, and EMS providers whose products require cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, or combination antennas.

Customer & Design-Win Development

  • Understand customer applications, RF/connectivity requirements, and program timing, and coordinate the right antenna solution.
  • Track antenna evaluations, samples, technical discussions, qualifications, and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel.
  • Initiate and schedule customer roadmap meetings to identify future programs and influence antenna selection early in the design cycle.
  • Maintain strong follow-up with prospects and customers from initial opportunity through technical evaluation and commercial conversion.

Sales Enablement & Channel Development

  • Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms, and distributors on Quectel antenna positioning, target applications, and sales messages.
  • Create account-specific selling strategies and support local teams in advancing antenna opportunities.
  • Provide competitive and market insights that help the wider sales organization win antenna business.

Product & Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, competitive gaps, and future roadmap needs.
  • Translate market feedback into actionable input for product planning and commercial strategy.
  • Coordinate internal resources to move strategic opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.

CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence

  • Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, and activity information in Salesforce CRM.
  • Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, meetings, risks, and next steps.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals, and major customer programs relevant to antenna growth in LATAM.
  • Attend trade shows and industry events to identify target accounts and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.


Qualifications & Experience

What we are looking for

  • (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2B technical sales, business development, or segment sales within antennas, RF components, wireless connectivity, IoT hardware, or a closely related field.
  • Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts, and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue.
  • Working understanding of customer design cycles and what it takes to win embedded hardware business.
  • Comfort discussing antenna use cases across cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and connected-device applications.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across a multi-country sales region.
  • Hands-on CRM discipline and clear funnel and business-review reporting.
  • Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English.
  • Willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development, and industry events.

Preferred background

  • Experience selling antennas, RF solutions, IoT modules, or related components to OEM/ODM/EMS customers.
  • Existing relationships within LATAM IoT, industrial, telematics, or tracking ecosystems.
  • Experience supporting distributors, representative firms, or channel partners.
  • Ability to collaborate with Product Management, FAE, and engineering teams on technical evaluations.
  • Familiarity with certification and homologation processes in LATAM markets (e.g., ANATEL, IFT).

What Success Looks Like

  • Growth in qualified antenna pipeline and new target accounts.
  • Increase in antenna design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions.
  • Higher antenna penetration across existing Quectel accounts.
  • Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through.
  • Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting.
  • Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.


About Quectel

Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate IoT innovation. We are an end-to-end global IoT solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R&D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our antenna business combines a broad standard portfolio with full custom design support — simulation, testing, tuning, and manufacturing.


Industries & Applications

Quectel’s modules and antennas power innovation across:

  • Smart metering and utilities
  • Asset tracking, telematics, and logistics
  • Smart agriculture
  • Smart cities and infrastructure
  • Industrial IoT and automation
  • Connected mobility and automotive
  • Smart home and consumer IoT

Why Quectel LATAM?

  • Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.
  • Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications.
  • Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with IoT experts across engineering, sales, and operations.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market in Brazil or Mexico
  • Uncapped sales commission tied to antenna revenue and design wins in your territory
  • Meal and grocery vouchers
  • Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents
  • Dental coverage
  • Life insurance and accident cover
  • Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law
  • International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization

title: Arquiteto SAP Sênior
description:
Função: Arquiteto SAP

Nivel: Sênior

Local: Remoto

Período: 24 meses, chance de prorrogar a indeterminado

Idioma: Inglês fluente

Perfil:

- Atuar como responsável pela arquitetura SAP durante o rollout de um Template Corporativo para aproximadamente 22 empresas, garantindo a aderência das implementações ao modelo definido, avaliando gaps e exceções, assegurando a governança arquitetural e evitando customizações ou desvios desnecessários do template.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto SAP Sênior/Principal.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação e/ou rollout SAP.
  • Experiência comprovada com SAP Template/Global Template.
  • Experiência em rollout para múltiplas empresas/unidades.
  • Conhecimento abrangente de SAP S/4HANA e/ou ECC.
  • Experiência em arquitetura de integrações SAP e não-SAP.
  • Conhecimento de ABAP, Fiori, APIs e integração suficiente para avaliação arquitetural.
  • Experiência em Fit-to-Template e Gap Analysis.
  • Experiência na gestão e aprovação de exceções ao template.
  • Capacidade de avaliar impactos de customizações.
  • Experiência em definição e documentação de arquitetura.
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos.

Desejável:

  • Experiência em SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com SAP BTP/CPI/Integration Suite.
  • Experiência com SAP Activate.
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação ECC → S/4HANA.
  • Experiência em grupos empresariais com múltiplas empresas.
  • Certificação SAP.
  • Experiência internacional.

title: Banco de Talentos - Engenheiro de Dados Sênior (Fabric)
description:
Profissionais com interesse em tecnologia e no universo de dados podem se cadastrar em nosso Banco de Talentos – Engenheiro de Dados Sênior (Fabric/Azure).


Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida , com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.


Contexto:

Busca-se profissional para atuação como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos estratégicos, com utilização da plataforma Microsoft Azure como base para desenvolvimento e integração, com foco em soluções utilizando Fabric.


Perfil técnico esperado:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com serviços em nuvem e soluções de dados na plataforma Azure.
  • Experiência com Microsoft Fabric.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação (Python, Java e Scala) e conhecimento avançado em SQL.
  • Conhecimentos em infraestrutura como código, utilizando Terraform.
  • Sólido conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, data warehouses e ferramentas de ETL.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de Big Data e processamento distribuído (como Hadoop e Spark).


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações em Azure Data Fundamentals, Azure Data Engineer Associate e Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate.
  • Inglês e/ou espanhol desejáveis.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação em modelo híbrido ou presencial na cidade de São Paulo – SP.


Escopo de atuação:

  • Liderança no desenho e na definição de arquiteturas de soluções de dados escaláveis.
  • Supervisão da construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes.
  • Gestão de grandes volumes de dados, com foco em otimização de performance dos sistemas.
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de processos de extração de dados complexos para Data Warehouses e Data Lakes.
  • Garantia de segurança, governança e conformidade dos dados.
  • Atuação junto a stakeholders para levantamento de requisitos de negócio e definição de estratégias e objetivos de dados.

title: Veterinary GCP Auditor
description:
Veterinary GCP Auditor (Contract) | Portuguese & English Fluent | Remote

We're supporting a specialist clinical research project in the animal health space and are looking for an experienced Veterinary GCP Auditor to join on a contract basis.


This is a highly targeted search, and we're only looking to present a small number of exceptional candidates. If you have extensive experience conducting Veterinary GCP (vGCP) audits and can operate independently, we'd love to hear from you.


Key Requirements

✅ Fluent Portuguese and English (essential)

✅ Minimum 5 years' experience conducting Veterinary GCP audits

✅ Strong knowledge of:

  • Veterinary GCP (vGCP)
  • VICH GL9 guidelines
  • Clinical study protocols
  • SOP compliance auditing
  • Local regulatory requirements
  • GLP principles and requirements

✅ Experience auditing veterinary clinical studies where patients are animals


Project Details

  • Remote opportunity
  • 3-6 audits anticipated
  • 1-2 days per audit
  • One auditor assigned per audit
  • Sites will be scheduled based on auditor availability
  • Audits will assess compliance against protocol, SOPs, local regulations, and VICH GL9 requirements


We're particularly interested in professionals who can demonstrate:

  • Independent audit delivery
  • Experience within animal health, veterinary pharmaceuticals, or veterinary clinical research
  • Strong stakeholder management and reporting skills
  • The ability to identify compliance risks and provide practical recommendations

Please Note

This assignment is moving quickly, and we're aiming to identify suitable candidates as soon as possible. Only candidates who closely match the required Veterinary GCP audit experience will be considered.

If this sounds like you, please get in touch with your CV and a brief overview of your Veterinary GCP audit experience.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Tech Lead / Arquiteto de Automação e IA
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead / Arquiteto(a) de Automação e IA para liderar uma iniciativa estratégica de transformação, sendo o principal responsável pela definição da arquitetura, governança e evolução de soluções de Inteligência Artificial e automação aplicadas às operações de TI.

Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico e estratégico, capaz de liderar equipes multidisciplinares, definir arquiteturas escaláveis e atuar como principal interlocutor técnico junto ao cliente e à liderança executiva.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar tecnicamente a iniciativa de Automação e IA, garantindo a evolução da arquitetura e das entregas do programa.
  • Definir a arquitetura de soluções envolvendo IA Generativa, agentes de IA, automação, integrações corporativas e observabilidade.
  • Revisar tecnicamente as entregas do squad, assegurando qualidade, segurança e aderência às melhores práticas.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de escalonamento para decisões e riscos técnicos.
  • Conduzir a priorização das demandas e apoiar a evolução da maturidade das soluções de IA.
  • Garantir governança, rastreabilidade, auditoria e segurança das soluções baseadas em LLMs.
  • Interagir diretamente com clientes, stakeholders e executivos na definição de estratégias e critérios de aceitação.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida como Tech Lead, Arquiteto(a) de Soluções ou Arquiteto(a) de Automação.
  • Vivência com arquitetura de soluções de Automação e Inteligência Artificial aplicada a operações de TI (AIOps, ITSM e Observabilidade).
  • Conhecimento em IA Generativa, LLMs, RAG, Grounding, Guardrails, Function Calling e arquiteturas baseadas em agentes.
  • Experiência com integração de plataformas como ServiceNow, Zabbix, Dynatrace, BigPanda ou soluções similares.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica de equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Vivência em definição de arquitetura, governança e segurança de soluções de IA.
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento com clientes e executivos.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel ou frameworks similares.
  • Certificações em Arquitetura Cloud (AWS ou Azure).
  • Certificação ITIL.
  • Experiência em programas de transformação digital, Managed Services ou grandes operações de TI.

title: Consultor de viagens sênior
description:
✨ Venha crescer com o Grupo Kontik ✨


O Grupo Kontik é um hub de negócios com mais de 70 anos de história no mercado de viagens, atuando em diferentes segmentos, como corporativo, lazer, luxo e eventos. Conectamos tradição e inovação com uma cultura de performance clara e praticada no dia a dia.

Nossa atuação é guiada por cinco pilares culturais, que orientam decisões, comportamentos e entregas:

• Performance e execução disciplinada, com foco em qualidade, prazos e resultados consistentes;

• Decisão inteligente e baseada em dados, priorizando análises, indicadores e escolhas bem fundamentadas;

• Colaboração e sinergia entre times, com comunicação clara e trabalho conjunto;

• Inovação, adaptabilidade e olhar para o futuro, evoluindo continuamente e ajustando rotas quando necessário;

• Viajante no centro, garantindo que nossas decisões gerem valor real para quem utiliza nossos serviços.


A oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) de Viagens Corporativas Pleno para atuar em uma operação dinâmica e estratégica de atendimento ao cliente corporativo.

Essa posição é ideal para profissionais com sólida experiência em viagens corporativas, autonomia na gestão das demandas do dia a dia e domínio das principais ferramentas utilizadas na operação, garantindo uma experiência consultiva e eficiente aos viajantes.

Você será responsável por conduzir processos de viagens nacionais e internacionais, oferecendo suporte especializado, respeitando SLAs, políticas de viagem e garantindo a melhor solução para cada solicitação.


Principais responsabilidades


Realizar atendimento consultivo a clientes corporativos por telefone, e-mail e plataformas de Self Booking;

Efetuar reservas, emissões, alterações e reemissões de serviços aéreos nacionais e internacionais;

Atuar com reservas de hotelaria, locação de veículos, transporte rodoviário e ferroviário;

Garantir o cumprimento dos SLAs estabelecidos, priorizando demandas conforme criticidade e urgência;

Utilizar sistemas GDS, OBTs e ferramentas de backoffice para gerenciamento das solicitações;

Apoiar clientes em processos de reembolso conforme regras tarifárias das companhias aéreas;

Orientar viajantes quanto à documentação necessária para viagens nacionais e internacionais;

Aplicar políticas de fornecedores e viagens corporativas durante os atendimentos;

Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências e mudanças do mercado de turismo corporativo;

Garantir qualidade operacional e excelência na experiência do cliente.



Como essa posição se conecta com nossa cultura

Aqui na Kontik, você terá a oportunidade de:

Entregar soluções com qualidade e foco em resultados;

Utilizar informações e indicadores para uma tomada de decisão mais assertiva;

Atuar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas e parceiros;

Adaptar-se rapidamente às necessidades dos clientes e às mudanças do mercado;

Colocar o viajante no centro de cada atendimento e solução proposta.


Experiência


Experiência consolidada em viagens corporativas;

Vivência em atendimento por telefone, e-mail e OBTs/Self Booking;

Experiência com processos aéreos e terrestres nacionais e internacionais;

Conhecimento em acompanhamento e gestão de SLA;

Vivência com reservas, emissões, alterações e reemissões.


Conhecimentos técnicos


Pacote Office Básico;

Excel Intermediário;

SABRE Intermediário;

Portais de companhias aéreas (e-Gol e e-Latam);

Reemissões voluntárias e involuntárias simples;

OBTs: Argo, Lemontech, Concur e Gover;

Backoffice Benner;

Portais de hotelaria, locadoras, rodoviários e trens;

Processos operacionais de viagens corporativas;

Reembolso conforme regras tarifárias;

Documentação de viagens (vistos e passaportes);

Cartões corporativos e formas de pagamento de despesas de viagem;

Conhecimento do mercado de turismo corporativo.


Formação: Ensino médio completo; ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Turismo, Administração, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas.


Idiomas: Inglês intermediário; Espanhol intermediário.



Informações da vaga

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 18h30 às 00h30, com uma folga durante a semana e escala de 10 horas aos finais de semana.

Benefícios:

• Vale-refeição em um cartão flexível que pode ser usado como VR e VA;

• \"Frutaria\" (entrega de frutas fresquinhas e higienizadas 02 vezes por semana para você ter uma alimentação ainda mais saudável);

• Vale-transporte;

• Assistência Médica Bradesco – sem custo para o Titular no Plano Efetivo IV E CE (permitida inclusão de cônjuge e filhos até 21 anos com pagamento integral da mensalidade);

• Assistência Odontológica Bradesco – sem custo para o Titular no Plano Básico (permitida inclusão de cônjuge e filhos até 21 anos, com pagamento integral da mensalidade);

• Seguro de Vida - sem custo para o colaborador;

• Plano de Carreira;

• \"PHD\" (Sorteio de bolsas de estudos anuais para quem está cursando graduação ou pós-graduação, para torná-lo(a) um profissional mais preparado);

• \"Hello, Hola, Ciao...\" (Sorteio de bolsas de estudo anual para idiomas);

• Qualify Kontik- Plataforma online com diversos cursos online;

• \"Diz Aí?\" (Canal aberto para sugestões, elogios ou para conversar conosco;

• \"Pega a visão!\" (Crédito no cartão benefício para compra de óculos ou lentes);

• \"Hoje a Festa é Sua!\" (Aniversariantes ganham o dia de folga);

• \"Você Muda & A Gente Ajuda!\" (Crédito em cartão benefício para ajudar na mudança de residência);

• \"Sim, Aceito!\" (Crédito em cartão benefício para ajudar no Casamento);

• Licença Casamento de 5 dias;

• \"Bebê a Bordo\" (Enviamos um Kit com itens básicos para futuras mamães e papais do Grupo Kontik);

• Auxílio creche para mães com filhos até 6 anos;

• \"PAI! Você é nosso herói!\" (Direito a licença paternidade de 30 dias após o nascimento do bebê);

• “Bday Filho(a)” (Dia livre no aniversário dos filhos de até 5 anos);

• Sorteio WOW Experience Travel! – sorteio de uma diária, com acompanhante em hospedagens na região da Unidade do Grupo, litoral e interior + vale divertido.

• Sorteio WOW na sua casa (sorteio de eletrodomésticos)

• \"Salvador Meu Amô!\" (Sorteio com acompanhante para conhecer a Cidade de Salvador, onde a Kontik nasceu, e um cartão diversão);

• Plataforma Kontik Trip – Passagens aéreas e hospedagem com descontos exclusivos para os colaboradores;

• \"Meu Amigo Vale Ouro!\" (sua indicação, se aprovada após o período de experiência e continuar na empresa rende um bônus para você);

• Wellhub (Gympass)

• Total Pass;

• Ingressos para o cinema com a Cinemark (preços muito mais acessíveis e desconto em folha).

• Convênio com a rede Raia Drogasil para compra de medicamentos com desconto em folha.

• Creditas - nossa parceira para realização de empréstimos consignado, oferecendo a opção de desconto diretamente em folha.

• Uhuu me formei – benefício para quem se formou

• Dinbora (Creditas) - App de educação e saúde financeira gratuito.

• Zenklub – App de Saúde mental, nutricional, financeira e carreira. Inclusão de dependentes com desconto em consultas.

• Dog Life Saúde para pet - cachorro e gatos

• “Bibi, passei” – Conquista da 1° habilitação, recebe um crédito no cartão ifood


Se você se identifica com uma cultura orientada a performance, decisões bem fundamentadas, colaboração, inovação contínua e foco no viajante, essa oportunidade pode ser o próximo passo da sua jornada no Grupo Kontik.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

We are seeking a talented Video Editor to create high-performing video content for paid social advertising campaigns. You will edit engaging, conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram Reels while working closely with our creative strategists and design team. This role requires fast turnaround capabilities, a keen understanding of performance creative principles, and the ability to manage multiple client projects simultaneously in a fully remote environment.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently high video output with exceptional quality and attention to detail
  • Strong creative performance metrics (CTR, watch time, engagement) across your video portfolio
  • Seamless collaboration with creative strategists, designers, and media buyers to iterate and optimize
  • Efficient project management and timely delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts


Responsibilities

  • Edit high-performing video ads for paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Execute on creative briefs and storyboards developed by creative strategists
  • Add motion graphics, text overlays, captions, and effects to enhance video storytelling and performance
  • Work with raw UGC footage and branded content to create attention-grabbing, under-15-second video ads
  • Iterate quickly on video concepts based on performance data and feedback from media buyers
  • Maintain brand consistency across multiple client accounts while adapting to different brand voices
  • Organize and manage video assets, project files, and creative libraries across all client accounts
  • Stay current on platform trends, best practices, and format specifications for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Meta
  • Collaborate with creative strategists on video concepts and provide input on creative direction
  • Conduct research on competitor ads and trending content to inform video creative approaches
  • Pull and optimize stills from videos for ad thumbnails and static creative variations
  • Participate in weekly design team meetings and collaborate with designers and fellow video editors


Requirements

  • 2-4 years of video editing experience, preferably in performance marketing or advertising
  • Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects
  • Motion graphics and animation capabilities
  • Portfolio demonstrating social-first video work for paid advertising (Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels)
  • Strong understanding of performance creative principles and direct response video best practices
  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and high volume output
  • Experience editing UGC (User Generated Content) and creator-style content
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong quality control standards
  • Fluent English communication skills for client collaboration and team coordination
  • DTC or ecommerce experience working with product-focused brands
  • Comfortable working remotely with distributed teams across multiple time zones


Nice to Have

  • Experience with CapCut or other mobile-first editing tools
  • Sound design and audio mixing skills
  • Understanding of TikTok and Instagram Reels trends and viral content strategies
  • Experience with color grading and advanced post-production techniques
  • Basic design skills in Figma or Adobe Creative Suite
  • Agency experience managing multiple concurrent client projects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience

With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

We are seeking a talented Video Editor to create high-performing video content for paid social advertising campaigns. You will edit engaging, conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram Reels while working closely with our creative strategists and design team. This role requires fast turnaround capabilities, a keen understanding of performance creative principles, and the ability to manage multiple client projects simultaneously in a fully remote environment.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently high video output with exceptional quality and attention to detail
  • Strong creative performance metrics (CTR, watch time, engagement) across your video portfolio
  • Seamless collaboration with creative strategists, designers, and media buyers to iterate and optimize
  • Efficient project management and timely delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts


Responsibilities

  • Edit high-performing video ads for paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Execute on creative briefs and storyboards developed by creative strategists
  • Add motion graphics, text overlays, captions, and effects to enhance video storytelling and performance
  • Work with raw UGC footage and branded content to create attention-grabbing, under-15-second video ads
  • Iterate quickly on video concepts based on performance data and feedback from media buyers
  • Maintain brand consistency across multiple client accounts while adapting to different brand voices
  • Organize and manage video assets, project files, and creative libraries across all client accounts
  • Stay current on platform trends, best practices, and format specifications for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Meta
  • Collaborate with creative strategists on video concepts and provide input on creative direction
  • Conduct research on competitor ads and trending content to inform video creative approaches
  • Pull and optimize stills from videos for ad thumbnails and static creative variations
  • Participate in weekly design team meetings and collaborate with designers and fellow video editors


Requirements

  • 2-4 years of video editing experience, preferably in performance marketing or advertising
  • Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects
  • Motion graphics and animation capabilities
  • Portfolio demonstrating social-first video work for paid advertising (Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels)
  • Strong understanding of performance creative principles and direct response video best practices
  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and high volume output
  • Experience editing UGC (User Generated Content) and creator-style content
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong quality control standards
  • Fluent English communication skills for client collaboration and team coordination
  • DTC or ecommerce experience working with product-focused brands
  • Comfortable working remotely with distributed teams across multiple time zones


Nice to Have

  • Sound design and audio mixing skills
  • Understanding of TikTok and Instagram Reels trends and viral content strategies
  • Experience with color grading and advanced post-production techniques
  • Basic design skills in Figma or Adobe Creative Suite
  • Agency experience managing multiple concurrent client projects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience

title: Sr. Workday Financials Consultant
description:
Senior Workday Financials Consultant

About the Role

Aspire is looking for a Senior Workday Financials Consultant to join our Finance Solution Delivery team on a contract basis.

In this role, you will serve as a versatile Workday Financials subject matter expert , supporting production operations, system enhancements, and strategic Finance transformation initiatives.

You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the Workday Financials platform remains stable, scalable, and continuously optimized.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced Workday Financials professional who can work independently, solve complex problems, and provide hands-on expertise across multiple Financials domains.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide hands-on configuration, administration, and production support across Workday Financials.
  • Troubleshoot system issues, investigate defects, and provide timely and effective resolutions.
  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions.
  • Support multiple Financials domains and adapt to changing business priorities.
  • Design, configure, and optimize Workday solutions with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and long-term platform health.
  • Deliver system enhancements, optimizations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with technical and functional teams on reporting, integrations, and platform enhancements .
  • Support strategic Finance transformation initiatives and future Workday capabilities.
  • Maintain clear and accurate documentation for configurations, business processes, and solution designs.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment with stakeholders across U.S. time zones.

Required Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of hands-on Workday Financials experience.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday .
  • Proven experience supporting both production environments and project-based initiatives .
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and systems-thinking skills.
  • Demonstrated expertise across multiple Workday Financials domains.

Priority Workday Financials Areas

Highest Priority

  • Financial Accounting
  • Expenses
  • Business Assets

Secondary Priority

  • Banking & Settlement

Nice to Have

  • VNDLY experience

Lower Priority

  • Procurement experience — the organization is gradually phasing this area out.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means you:

  • Seamlessly support multiple Workday Financials domains based on business priorities.
  • Reduce the production support backlog and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders.
  • Deliver scalable, maintainable solutions rather than short-term fixes.
  • Resolve issues efficiently while minimizing business disruption.
  • Become a trusted extension of the core Workday team.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and long-term Finance transformation initiatives.

Why Aspire?

  • Join a Remote-First organization.
  • Work alongside exceptional technology professionals from around the world.
  • Access continuous technical and professional development opportunities.
  • Gain international exposure by collaborating with global technology leaders.
  • Receive nursery reimbursement benefits.
  • Participate in virtual and onsite international technology conferences.
  • Work within an IT environment aligned with rigorous security and compliance standards, including ISO and SOC frameworks .

title: Junior Recruiter (Remote)
description:
The Junior Recruiter supports the Talent Acquisition function by identifying, engaging, and assessing early-career and emerging talent. This role provides foundational support in sourcing, candidate management, and market research, enabling the organization to build high-quality talent pipelines and enhance hiring outcomes. The Junior Recruiter operates with curiosity, discipline, and a growth mindset, contributing to a proactive and insight-led approach to recruitment.


Global Market Mapping & Talent Intelligence

  • Support the creation and maintenance of basic talent maps across priority roles and regions.
  • Conduct preliminary research into competitor and industry talent pools.
  • Monitor emerging skills and support insights that inform Talent Partners.
  • Assist in translating basic market findings into structured summaries and recommendations.


Proactive Sourcing & Candidate Identification

  • Assist in sourcing passive candidates for early-career and specialist roles using multiple channels.
  • Screen profiles to assess alignment with role requirements.
  • Engage talent through professional, timely communication to build candidate interest.
  • Maintain organized, high-quality talent pipelines within recruitment systems.


Partnership with Talent Partners

  • Support Talent Partners with research, shortlists, and candidate outreach.
  • Contribute to search strategies with relevant market findings.
  • Help prepare candidate summaries, insights, and support documents.
  • Collaborate closely to ensure alignment with hiring priorities and talent plans.


Candidate Experience & Process Excellence

  • Ensure candidates receive timely, clear, and professional communication throughout the process.
  • Coordinate interviews, assessments, and feedback loops.
  • Uphold high standards of confidentiality and professionalism.
  • Support improvements to recruitment processes, tools, and efficiency.


Employer Brand & External Presence

  • Represent the organization positively when interacting with external talent.
  • Share the employer value proposition clearly and consistently.
  • Contribute to targeted outreach campaigns and engagement initiatives.


Tools, Technology & Data Discipline

  • Maintain accurate candidate and pipeline data within recruiting tools.
  • Use sourcing platforms and talent intelligence tools with increasing proficiency.
  • Support basic reporting and pipeline updates for Talent Partners.


Candidate Profile

Experience & Capability

  • Previous experience in recruitment, sourcing, HR, or related areas.
  • Previous experience in recruitment for US companies or Global market - desirable
  • Previous experience in recruitment in LATAM region - desirable
  • Exposure to research, sourcing, or candidate engagement preferred.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks with strong attention to detail.


Technical Strength

  • Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter or similar sourcing tools.
  • Strong organizational and data-management skills.
  • Advanced English required.
  • Spanish - intermediate


Mindset & Behaviours

  • Curious, proactive, and eager to learn about talent markets and recruitment best practices.
  • Resilient and comfortable working in fast-paced environments.
  • Professional communicator who can build rapport with candidates and stakeholders.
  • Team-oriented with a growth mindset.


Working Scheme: remote

Contract: Full time - Indefinite period.

title: UX Designer (Physical Product | LATAM)
description:
UX Designer (Physical Products & DTC Experience)


Carepod is a premium home wellness brand focused on creating thoughtfully designed consumer products that improve everyday life.

We’re looking for a UX Designer to help us create intuitive, customer-centered experiences across our physical products and digital customer journey. This role combines product usability, customer research, website UX, and customer experience , helping shape everything from product interactions to online purchasing and onboarding.

You’ll work closely with Product Development, Marketing, Customer Support, and HQ to transform customer insights into better products and better experiences.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys owning projects, collaborating across teams, and making a measurable impact on how customers experience our brand.


What You’ll Do

🧪 Product UX & Customer Research

  • Conduct product usability testing and customer research
  • Analyze customer reviews, support conversations, surveys, and behavioral insights
  • Identify friction points and recommend customer-focused improvements
  • Build personas, journey maps, and usability documentation

Website UX

  • Improve website and e-commerce user experience
  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and UX recommendations
  • Partner with Marketing to optimize customer education and conversion
  • Improve online product presentation and navigation

Product Experience

  • Improve packaging, onboarding, and instructional materials
  • Collaborate with Product Development on customer-centered product improvements
  • Support user testing for new products and accessories
  • Ensure consistency across physical and digital customer touch points

🤝 Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Development, Marketing, Customer Support, Operations, and HQ
  • Present research findings and UX recommendations
  • Help coordinate initiatives that improve the overall customer experience


What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will help us:

  • Deliver more intuitive customer experiences
  • Improve website usability and customer conversion
  • Reduce customer confusion and support contacts
  • Improve packaging and onboarding experiences
  • Turn customer feedback into actionable product improvements

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in UX Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, or a related field
  • Experience with direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands
  • Strong UX research and usability testing experience
  • Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and journey maps
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to independently manage multiple projects
  • Strong attention to detail and customer-first mindset

Nice to Have

  • Customer Experience (CX) background
  • Packaging or unboxing design experience
  • Experience with consumer products or home appliances
  • Shopify or Amazon experience
  • Experience improving product onboarding or customer education

Tools

  • Figma
  • Adobe Creative Suite

Who Will Thrive Here

  • Someone who enjoys solving customer problems through thoughtful design
  • Someone who likes balancing research and execution
  • Someone who works well independently while collaborating across teams
  • Someone who enjoys fast-moving environments and high ownership

Who May Not Be a Fit

  • Someone interested only in UI for software products
  • Someone uncomfortable working across multiple business functions
  • Someone who requires highly structured processes and close supervision

title: [CS] Analista de Customer Success Sênior | RH
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Customer Success III para atuar de forma estratégica na gestão de uma carteira de clientes Enterprise, sendo responsável por impulsionar a adoção das soluções, fortalecer o relacionamento executivo e atuar diretamente na retenção e expansão do valor percebido pelos clientes.



Procuramos um profissional sênior, com sólida experiência de mercado, alta autonomia e capacidade de conduzir agendas complexas, articulando diferentes áreas da empresa para garantir a melhor experiência ao cliente e o atingimento dos resultados de negócios.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Gerenciar estrategicamente uma carteira de clientes de grande porte (Enterprise).
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamento com executivos e tomadores de decisão dos clientes.
  • Construir planos de sucesso alinhados aos objetivos de negócio dos clientes.
  • Conduzir agendas executivas, QBRs, comitês e reuniões de acompanhamento com alto nível de consultoria.
  • Atuar de forma proativa na identificação e mitigação de riscos de churn.
  • Elaborar e executar estratégias para aumento da adoção das soluções e geração de valor contínuo.
  • Liderar internamente as demandas dos clientes, envolvendo os stakeholders necessários (Produto, Suporte, Comercial, Implantação, Marketing, entre outros), sem depender da atuação direta da liderança.
  • Influenciar decisões e promover alinhamento entre as áreas para garantir a evolução das iniciativas dos clientes.
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão de relacionamento e geração de novos negócios em parceria com as áreas comerciais.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de sucesso do cliente, propondo planos de ação sempre que necessário.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Experiência sólida em Customer Success, Customer Experience, Consultoria ou Gestão de Contas Estratégicas.
  • Vivência na gestão de grandes contas (Enterprise).
  • Conhecimento do mercado de Recursos Humanos (RH), HCM ou tecnologia para RH.
  • Experiência em relacionamento com executivos (Diretores, Heads, CHROs e C-Level).
  • Capacidade de conduzir negociações e conversas estratégicas em ambientes complexos.
  • Perfil altamente consultivo, analítico e orientado à geração de valor para o cliente.
  • Elevada autonomia, protagonismo e senso de dono.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Facilidade para articulação e influência de stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Experiência em estratégias de adoção, engajamento, retenção e mitigação de churn.


SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Experiência em empresas SaaS ou de tecnologia B2B.
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de Customer Success (Health Score, NPS, Adoção, Churn, Renovação, Expansão, MRR/ARR).
  • Vivência com soluções de RH, HCM, folha, ponto, recrutamento, performance ou gestão de pessoas.
  • Experiência na condução de projetos multifuncionais.

title: Promo Writer (Brasil)
description:
Promo Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.

Role Overview

As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.

The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.

You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.


Key Responsibilities


1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing

  • Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series.
  • Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance.
  • Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series.
  • Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production.
  • Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series.

2. Adaptation & Localization

  • Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience.
  • Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market.
  • Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts.

3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement

  • Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity.
  • Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments.
  • Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction.
  • Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards.

4. Production-Ready Script Delivery

  • Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required.
  • Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute.
  • Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed.
  • Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution.

5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses

  • Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement.
  • Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization.
  • Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos.
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance.

6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration

  • Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams.
  • Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines.
  • Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets.
  • Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response.

7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization

  • Use GenAI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement.
  • Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards.
  • Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.



Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content.
  • Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences.
  • Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers.
  • Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred.
  • Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams.
  • Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.

They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM
